items.title: 6.10 Machine learning ke tools aur platforms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of machine learning tools and platforms (PDF 88-89).

blocks.text: Machine learning data jama, process aur tajzia karne aur models banane ke liye mukhtalif tools use karti hai. Kuch saade aur naye seekhne walon ke liye asan hain; kuch advanced kaam ko sahara dete hain. Har aik ki apni khoobiyan hain, aur sahi tool chunna kaar-amadi aur durusti barhata hai.

blocks.caption: Aam tools
rows: Rows aur columns mein bunyadi data tajzia
Sorting, filtering, charts aur saade formulas; seekhna asan; chhote datasets aur naye seekhne walon ke liye achha
Data tajzie ki programming zaban, tehqeeq mein aam
Data dikhane ke liye mazboot graphics; bare datasets; data science ke bohat se packages
Machine learning ki sab se maqbool zaban
pandas, NumPy, matplotlib aur scikit-learn jaisi libraries; Jupyter code aur nataij aik interactive notebook mein saath dikhata; industry mein aam

blocks.text: Naye seekhne wale aksar data samajhne ke liye Excel se shuru karte, shumariyati tajzie ke liye R par jate, aur 6.6 ki regression misal jaise machine learning models banane ke liye Python use karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aap kaun sa tool chunenge (a) class ke number ka jaldi chart banane ke liye, (b) grades ka andaza lagane wala model train karne ke liye? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: (a) Excel: yeh chhote tables asani se sort aur chart karta hai. (b) Python (maslan Jupyter notebook mein) scikit-learn jaisi libraries ke saath, jo tayyar machine learning models deti hain.

items: Excel: chhote data ke liye saada tajzia aur charts.
R: tehqeeq ke liye shumariyat aur graphics.
Python aur Jupyter: machine learning ke liye libraries aur interactive notebooks.
